_comment: TEMPLATE -- no real values. Per docs/FINAL_PROTOCOL.md / docs/SUCCESS_CRITERION.md, the final held-out evaluation (seeds 3000-3199) has not run yet: as of pipeline/runs/revised_A/summary.txt (commit 8864bd4), arm A's first runs all produced 'no rule', and no arm_B directory exists yet, so there is nothing to evaluate. Every field below is null until that evaluation actually runs; do not fill this in by hand -- regenerate it from the real evaluator output (pipeline/evaluate_heldout.py).

_field_meanings.evaluation_ts: UTC timestamp the final evaluation was run, ISO 8601. Null until seeds 3000-3199 are used (once, per FINAL_PROTOCOL.md).
_field_meanings.k_rules_evaluated: Bonferroni k: total count of gate-passing rules across every revised run, both arms (docs/SUCCESS_CRITERION.md item B). The denominator for the corrected McNemar significance threshold (0.05/k).
_field_meanings.arms: Per-arm summary, keyed 'A' (DeepSeek-V4-Flash) and 'B' (Gemma, per docs/REVISION.md). Each arm: runs_executed, runs_with_gate_passing_rule, rules (list of per-rule result objects), no_rule_runs (count reported as 'no safe rule', per item F).
_field_meanings.rules[].rule_id: The Rule.rule_id of a gate-passing rule from some run.
_field_meanings.rules[].cell_b_drop_rate_with_rule: Cell B (seeds 3000-3099) drop rate with the rule active.
_field_meanings.rules[].cell_b_drop_rate_without_rule: Cell B drop rate at the nominal baseline, same seeds, for the paired comparison.
_field_meanings.rules[].mcnemar_p: Paired exact McNemar p-value, cell B, rule vs baseline (docs/SUCCESS_CRITERION.md item D.i).
_field_meanings.rules[].meets_success_criterion: True iff mcnemar_p < 0.05/k_rules_evaluated AND cell C drop rate does not increase AND crush count does not increase on either cell (item D).
_field_meanings.rules[].cell_c_drop_rate_with_rule: Cell C (seeds 3100-3199) drop rate with the rule active -- must not be higher than without it (item D.ii).
_field_meanings.rules[].crush_count_cell_b: Crush count on cell B with the rule active -- must not increase vs baseline (item D.iii).
_field_meanings.rules[].crush_count_cell_c: Crush count on cell C with the rule active -- must not increase vs baseline (item D.iii).
_field_meanings.rules[].wilson_ci95_drop_rate_with_rule: [lower, upper] Wilson 95% CI of the with-rule drop rate.
_field_meanings.baselines: Per FINAL_PROTOCOL.md: 'no rule', 'naive 0.9x crush limit', 'near-limit heuristic', and 'v2.1-aware grid rule' (reported as 'none passes' if none does) -- each rule above is compared against every baseline, not just the nominal setting.
_field_meanings.feasibility_table: List of {baseline_name, drop_rate, crush_count, wilson_ci95} for each of the four baselines above, measured on the same held-out seeds, for context alongside the rule comparisons.
_field_meanings.headline: Per docs/SUCCESS_CRITERION.md item E: runs executed, runs yielding a gate-passing rule, of those how many meet the success criterion, and the Wilson intervals -- deliberately no single 'best rule' headline.
